arabic text: SAR PEET KE BOLE HARAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA\nMATAM KO SAB UTHO BAHAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: Beating their heads, the sacred ladies cried: Abbas's standard has returned.\nAll rise together for matam—Abbas's standard has returned.

arabic text: PANJA NAZAR JAB AAGAYA HANS KAR SAKINA NE KAHAA\nBE AAB THE BETAAB HUM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: When the hand emblem appeared, Sakina smiled and said:\nwe were thirsty and restless—Abbas's standard has returned.

arabic text: MASHKIZA BINTE SHAAH KA CHOBE ALAM SE HAI BANDHA\nKIS SHAAN SE AY EHLE GHAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: The daughter of the King's water-skin is tied to the staff of the standard.\nWith what majesty, O mourners, Abbas's standard has returned.

arabic text: PARCHAM LAHU SE LAAL HAI MASHKIZA BHI GIRBAAL HAI\nAFZU(N) NA HO KYUN KAR ALAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: The banner is red with blood, and the water-skin is pierced like a sieve.\nWhy should grief not increase? Abbas's standard has returned.

arabic text: WAAQIF SAKINA HOEGI, KYA KYA TARAP KAR ROWEGI\nAB KYU NA HO BAA CHASM E NAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: Sakina will understand; how painfully she will weep.\nWhy should every eye not fill with tears? Abbas's standard has returned.

arabic text: PAAN WOH LAAE HOENGE KHAALI NA AAYE HOENGE\nSAD SHUKR AYA DAM ME DAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: He must have brought water; he would not have returned empty-handed.\nA hundred thanks—life has returned to our breath; Abbas's standard has returned.

arabic text: ZAINAB NE RO RO KAR KAHAA, NADAAN TU SAMJHI HAI KYA\nJAB LAAE SULTAN E UMAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: Weeping, Zainab said: innocent child, what have you understood?\nWhen the King of the nations brought it back—Abbas's standard had returned.

arabic text: MAARA GAYA TERA CHACHA JAAN APNI KI TUJH PER FIDA\nDENE KO DARD O RANJ O GHAM AAYA ALAM ABBAS KA
english translation text: Your dear uncle has been killed; he sacrificed his life for you.\nTo bring you pain, sorrow and grief, Abbas's standard has returned.
